units.intent: Cluster test for the blocking-queue time-based rate limiter: verifies SetBlockingQueueTimeRateLimit's window/threshold settings round-trip through Status, and that a burst of conflicting commands sharing an identifier trips per-identifier blocking once its threshold is exceeded.

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest
objects.role: the whole scenario

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::setup/teardown
objects.role: own the BedrockClusterTester

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::before
objects.role: runs before each TEST(): clears rate-limit state and resets conflict retries

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::testControlCommands
objects.role: sets window/threshold values and checks they round-trip through Status

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::testTimeRateLimiting
objects.role: forces conflicts on a shared identifier from three threads, checks some requests are refused (503) and the identifier shows blocked

naming_quality.note: clear, consistent with sibling control-command tests

units.intent: Regression test (PR #2600) for leader/follower divergence with named bound SQL parameters: confirms a leader write round-trips correctly and journals the inlined SQL literal rather than the raw placeholder text, and exercises the same path through RemoteSQLite.

objects.name: BoundParametersTest
objects.role: the whole scenario

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::setup/teardown
objects.role: own a 3-node BedrockClusterTester

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::queryServer
objects.role: runs a JSON-format Query and deserializes the SQResult

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::getCommitCount
objects.role: reads a node's Status commit count

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::readJournalText
objects.role: reads and decompresses one journal row's query text for a given commit ID

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::testBoundParamReplication
objects.role: writes a bound-param value on leader, waits for followers to catch up, checks the replicated row and journal text on every node

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::testRemoteSQLiteForwardsParams
objects.role: writes and reads back a row through RemoteSQLite with bound params, checking values didn't bind to NULL

units.intent: Cluster-level stress test that fires large volumes of conflicting writes at all three nodes concurrently, then verifies the cluster converges to identical data, journals, and row counts with zero request failures.

objects.name: ConflictSpamTest
objects.role: tpunit::TestFixture running a serial then a multi-threaded conflicting-write stress scenario against a default three-node cluster

naming_quality.note: test method names `slow` and `spam` are generic on their own, though the class name and header comment supply context

units.intent: Cluster test that manufactures a fork: advances a follower's journal past the stopped leader's, corrupts the leader's own last journal-entry hash with a raw sqlite3 write, restarts it, and verifies it aborts (SIGABRT) rather than rejoining.

objects.name: ForkCheckTest
objects.role: the whole scenario

objects.name: ForkCheckTest::getMaxJournalCommit
objects.role: finds the highest commit ID (and its journal table) across a node's journal* tables

objects.name: ForkCheckTest::createThreads
objects.role: spawns worker threads spamming idcollision commands at rotating nodes, avoiding a known-down leader

objects.name: ForkCheckTest::forkAtShutDown
objects.role: drives the scenario: builds a 5-node cluster, stops leader under load, hand-corrupts its last commit hash, restarts it, asserts SIGABRT

misfits.why: neither the SQLite nor SQLiteNode class is referenced in this file; only the raw sqlite3 C API (sqlite3_open_v2/sqlite3_exec/sqlite3_close_v2) is used, which these headers only supply transitively

units.intent: Cluster test for successive leader failures on a 5-node cluster: kills the leader twice with enough writes between failures that returning nodes must pass through SYNCHRONIZING before re-leading or following, and verifies that sequence is actually observed.

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest
objects.role: the whole scenario

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::runTrivialWrites
objects.role: issues a batch of trivial UPDATE/INSERT writes to advance a node's commit count

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::waitForCommit
objects.role: polls a node's Status until its commitCount reaches a minimum, or times out

objects.name: MultipleLeaderSyncTest::test
objects.role: builds the cluster, fails leader twice while writing between failures, restarts both downed nodes concurrently, and watches each pass through the expected state sequence
